# BarkFlair

> BarkFlair (Bark Flair LLC) is a US registered video editing agency for real estate agents, car detailing businesses and YouTube creators. We edit listing reels and property tours, Meta video ads and reels for detailing businesses, talking-head YouTube videos and Shorts, short-form content, VSLs, UGC ads and commercials. Contact: hello@barkflair.com

## Services
- [Video editor in Florida](https://barkflair.com/video-editor-florida/): video editing for Florida businesses, agents and creators (Miami, Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville). Remote, US-registered agency.
- [Car detailing video editing in Florida](https://barkflair.com/car-detailing-video-editing-florida/): Meta ads and reels for Florida detailers.
- [Real estate video editing](https://barkflair.com/real-estate-video-editing/): listing reels, property tours and agent brand videos for US agents. $50–150 per video, first edit $30, 24–48h delivery.
- [Florida real estate video editing](https://barkflair.com/real-estate-video-editing-florida/): Miami, Orlando, Tampa and across Florida.
- [Texas real estate video editing](https://barkflair.com/real-estate-video-editing-texas/): Houston, Dallas–Fort Worth, Austin, San Antonio and across Texas.
- [Car detailing video ads](https://barkflair.com/car-detailing-video-editing/): Meta ad test packs ($250: one ad, 3 hooks, 9:16 and 4:5, ad copy), detailing reels and monthly creative ($400/month).
- [YouTube video editing](https://barkflair.com/youtube-video-editing/): talking-head YouTube videos ($150–400 per video) and Shorts ($50–100 each).
- [Short-form video editing](https://barkflair.com/short-form-video-editing/): Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, $50–150 per video.
- [Video ad editing](https://barkflair.com/video-ad-editing/): Meta and TikTok ads with hook variations.
- [UGC video editing](https://barkflair.com/ugc-video-editing/)
- [VSL editing](https://barkflair.com/vsl-editing/): from $400.
- [TV and commercial editing](https://barkflair.com/commercial-video-editing/)

## Portfolio
- [Video editing portfolio](https://barkflair.com/portfolio/): real estate reels and tours, Meta ads, YouTube talking-head videos, podcasts, VSLs, SaaS explainers, commercials and more.

## Proof
- [Blue Ridge (grew from $4K to $54K in monthly sales, Jan–Jul 2026, while running BarkFlair ads and website) Mobile Detailing case study](https://barkflair.com/case-studies/blue-ridge-mobile-detailing/): one Meta ad, $23.37 spend, 16 leads, 4 sales, $1,695 revenue.
